reason: This is an app, not a marketing page: pill CTAs are the one action style, square tab and option controls are form controls by design.
The step headings name the product's own parts — FairScope, ChangeLock, PayProof, Dispute — in Bangla; the checker matches English nouns only.
The app section is a working multi-view form (login, FairScope wizard, job detail with six tabs); its height follows the visible view, so a fixed one-or-two-screen marketing rule does not apply.
